description: Your whole Garmin history in a local database, not one 28-day page at a time.

env_var_specs.name: GARMIN_ACCESS_TOKEN
env_var_specs.description: An access token obtained elsewhere. Garmin issues no personal API key, so there is normally nothing to put here — run `auth login` instead. A token set here is used as-is, is never refreshed, and is not the account `auth status` reports for this home.

tools.name: account_personal-information
tools.description: Returns the identity block for the signed-in account, including the account email. That email is the only field on any Garmin response that names which account a token belongs to, so `auth login` reads it immediately after the token exchange and refuses to store a token whose account does not match the one the operator named. Run it before trusting a home that a shared browser session may have filled with the wrong household member. Optional: DI-Backend.

params.name: DI-Backend
params.description: Request header used only by Garmin's older cookie-based auth path.

tools.name: account_settings
tools.description: Returns the account's settings. Read this once per home to learn whether the account reports distances in metric or statute units before formatting any distance, pace or weight. Optional: DI-Backend.

params.name: DI-Backend
params.description: Request header used only by Garmin's older cookie-based auth path.

tools.name: account_social-profile
tools.description: Returns the account's public profile. The `displayName` field is the account key that several other Garmin paths interpolate, so this is the first call after a login and the cheapest way to confirm a stored token still works: a 401 or 403 here means the token was rejected by the data tier. Optional: DI-Backend.

params.name: DI-Backend
params.description: Request header used only by Garmin's older cookie-based auth path.

tools.name: activities_breakdown
tools.description: Server-side aggregation of every activity on the account into totals per parent activity type, by duration or distance. Answers 'what does this account actually do, and how much' in one request instead of paging the whole activity list. Required: startDate, endDate, aggregation (default: lifetime), groupByParentActivityType (default: true), metric (default: distance). Optional: DI-Backend. Returns the FreeFormObject.

params.name: DI-Backend
params.description: Request header used only by Garmin's older cookie-based auth path.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Start date

params.name: endDate
params.description: End date

params.name: aggregation
params.description: Aggregation

params.name: groupByParentActivityType
params.description: Garmin expects the capitalised literal strings `True` and `False` here, not lowercase.

params.name: metric
params.description: Metric

tools.name: activities_download-original
tools.description: Fetches the original recorded file for one activity as a ZIP containing the device FIT file. This is the sanctioned export route for raw per-second data that the JSON endpoints do not expose. Binary response; write it to a file rather than parsing it. Required: activityId. Optional: DI-Backend.

params.name: DI-Backend
params.description: Request header used only by Garmin's older cookie-based auth path.

params.name: activityId
params.description: Numeric activity id, the `activityId` field of a row from `activities list`.

tools.name: activities_get
tools.description: Everything Garmin holds about one activity at summary level: type, timing, distance and elevation. Aggregate heart rate and power come with it. Take the id from the activity list. Required: activityId. Optional: DI-Backend. Returns the ActivitySummary.

params.name: DI-Backend
params.description: Request header used only by Garmin's older cookie-based auth path.

params.name: activityId
params.description: Numeric activity id, the `activityId` field of a row from `activities list`.

tools.name: activities_hr-time-in-zones
tools.description: Seconds spent in each configured heart-rate zone during one activity. That is the raw material for a training-polarisation ratio across a season. Combine with the zone settings to label the zones. Required: activityId. Optional: DI-Backend. Returns the FreeFormObject.

params.name: DI-Backend
params.description: Request header used only by Garmin's older cookie-based auth path.

params.name: activityId
params.description: Numeric activity id, the `activityId` field of a row from `activities list`.

tools.name: activities_list
tools.description: The account's activity feed, one row per recorded activity, newest first. Pages with `--offset` and `--limit`; an empty page means the end of the account's history. Optional filters narrow by date range, activity type and sort order. Distinct local start dates over this list are how 'days active' is counted — Garmin exposes no server-side count. Optional: DI-Backend, offset (default: 0), limit (default: 20) (plus 5 more). Returns array of ActivitySummary.

params.name: DI-Backend
params.description: Request header used only by Garmin's older cookie-based auth path.

params.name: offset
params.description: Zero-based offset into the activity feed; 0 is the most recent activity. Sent to Garmin as the `start` query parameter.

params.name: limit
params.description: Page size. Other clients cap this at 1000 as a safety measure; Garmin publishes no ceiling of its own.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Start date

params.name: endDate
params.description: End date

params.name: activityType
params.description: Filter to one activity type, for example cycling, running, swimming, multi_sport, fitness_equipment, hiking, walking or other.

params.name: activitySubType
params.description: Activity sub type

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Garmin defaults to descending by startLocal; `asc` returns oldest first.

tools.name: activities_splits
tools.description: The lap or split breakdown of a single activity, each with its own distance, duration and averages. Present for activities the device or the user split. Required: activityId. Optional: DI-Backend. Returns the FreeFormObject.

params.name: DI-Backend
params.description: Request header used only by Garmin's older cookie-based auth path.

params.name: activityId
params.description: Numeric activity id, the `activityId` field of a row from `activities list`.

tools.name: fitness_age
tools.description: Garmin's fitness-age estimate and the components it was computed from for a single date. There is no range form, so a fitness-age trend costs one request per day and is what the local archive exists for. Required: date. Optional: DI-Backend. Returns the FreeFormObject.

params.name: DI-Backend
params.description: Request header used only by Garmin's older cookie-based auth path.

params.name: date
params.description: Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: fitness_max-metrics
tools.description: Fitness-level trend: VO2 max, generic and cycling, plus Garmin's max-met value, one row per date. Only dates with a measurement appear; days without a qualifying activity are absent rather than zero. At most 28 calendar days per request. Required: start, end. Optional: DI-Backend. Returns the FreeFormObject.

params.name: DI-Backend

tools.name: heart_rate_daily

This is the account-scoped path variant. Required: displayName, date. Optional: DI-Backend. Returns array of HeartRateDailyItem.

params.name: DI-Backend
params.description: Request header used only by Garmin's older cookie-based auth path.

params.name: date

params.name: DI-Backend
params.description: Request header used only by Garmin's older cookie-based auth path.

params.name: date

tools.name: heart_rate_zones
tools.description: The zone boundaries the account has configured, per sport. These are settings, not measurements: read them to label time-in-zone numbers, and expect them to change only when the user edits them or Garmin auto-detects a new threshold. Optional: DI-Backend. Returns array of FreeFormObject.

params.name: DI-Backend
params.description: Request header used only by Garmin's older cookie-based auth path.

tools.name: sleep_night
tools.description: Everything Garmin recorded for a single night: stage minutes, sleep windows, restlessness and the sleep-score breakdown. One request per night, so a trend question should use the range commands instead. This is the account-scoped path variant; `night-alt` is the same payload without the displayName in the path. Required: displayName, date. Optional: DI-Backend, nonSleepBufferMinutes (default: 60). Returns the DailySleepData.

params.name: DI-Backend
params.description: Request header used only by Garmin's older cookie-based auth path.

params.name: displayName

params.name: date

params.name: nonSleepBufferMinutes
params.description: Minutes of buffer around the sleep window. 60 is the value Garmin's own clients send.

tools.name: sleep_night-alt
tools.description: Identical payload to `night`, on the sleep-service path that takes the date as a query parameter. It needs no displayName, so it works before the bootstrap profile call has run, and it is the fallback if the account-scoped path ever changes. Required: date. Optional: DI-Backend. Returns the DailySleepData.

params.name: DI-Backend
params.description: Request header used only by Garmin's older cookie-based auth path.

params.name: date

Cheaper than fetching per-night detail when the question is about a trend rather than one night. At most 28 calendar days per request. Required: start, end. Optional: DI-Backend. Returns array of SleepScoreDay.

params.name: DI-Backend

At most 28 calendar days per request; `history` fills longer ranges into the local archive in 28-day windows, oldest day first, de-duplicating on the calendar date. Rows arrive under `individualStats`. Required: start, end. Optional: DI-Backend. Returns array of SleepStatsDay.

params.name: DI-Backend
params.description: Request header used only by Garmin's older cookie-based auth path.

Returns array of DailyStepsDay.

params.name: DI-Backend
params.description: Request header used only by Garmin's older cookie-based auth path.

Use this for long-horizon trend questions and fall back to the daily form when a specific date matters. Required: end, weeks (default: 52). Optional: DI-Backend. Returns array of WeeklyStepsRow.

Returns a page of days, not a single day; treat the end date as the anchor. Requires `--end`. Required: end. Optional: DI-Backend.

novel_features.name: Sleep over a window, joined and compared
novel_features.description: Duration, score, stage split and resting heart rate for a window of nights, with the equally long window before it beside them.

novel_features.name: Training load, zone split and fitness trend in one read
novel_features.description: Archived activities grouped by type with their time and distance, time summed per heart-rate zone, weekly load buckets, and the VO2-max and readiness trends beside them.

novel_features.name: Oldest-first archive fill of the 28-day-capped series
novel_features.description: Fills a local SQLite archive of every Garmin daily series from the oldest day forward, keeping one bookmark per series so an interrupted run resumes instead of restarting.

novel_features.name: SQL over the whole archive, read-only by construction
novel_features.description: Ask the archive anything in SQL: one read-only SELECT across every series `history` has filled.

novel_features.name: Loopback browser login with identity assertion
novel_features.description: Refuses to store a token whose account is not the address you named, so a shared browser cannot sign the wrong household member in.
